description:
Perform tax loss harvesting analysis on the 'Semiconductors' portfolio in JStock. 

Goal: Identify the stock position with the lowest (most negative) Gain/Loss Percentage and flag it for harvesting.

Instructions:
1. Open the 'Semiconductors' portfolio (File > Open Portfolio or via the Portfolio Management tab).
2. Review the 'Gain/Loss %' column for all held positions.
3. Identify the stock with the worst performance (lowest negative percentage).
4. Edit that specific transaction.
5. Add the exact text "Harvest Loss" to the 'Comment' field.
6. Save the change and save the portfolio.

Do not modify units, prices, or dates. Do not modify any other positions.
